phases.name: Year 1
phases.subtitle: Explore
phases.description: Marketing Foundations & Self-Discovery — Explore marketing careers, build business literacy, and develop consumer insight skills.

milestones.label: Complete CliftonStrengths assessment and marketing career mapping
milestones.description: Complete the Gallup CliftonStrengths assessment and connect signature themes to marketing career pathways including brand management, digital marketing, market research, advertising, and product management.

milestones.label: Master principles of marketing
milestones.description: Introduction to marketing strategy, the marketing mix (4Ps), consumer behavior, market segmentation, and brand positioning. Students analyze real brands and develop a marketing plan for a local business.

milestones.label: Build financial literacy for marketing professionals
milestones.description: Introduction to financial statements and the accounting cycle. Students build the financial literacy needed to analyze marketing ROI, budget allocation, and campaign performance.

milestones.label: Join American Marketing Association student chapter
milestones.description: Join AMA student chapter, Ad Club, or CoBE Marketing Club. Attend brand case study events, marketing competitions, and connect with marketing professionals.

milestones.label: Analyze global consumer behavior and market trends
milestones.description: Examine economic principles that drive consumer behavior, market demand, and purchasing patterns across local and global markets. Students connect economic theory to marketing strategy.

phases.name: Year 2
phases.subtitle: Engage
phases.description: Digital Marketing & Market Research — Build digital marketing expertise and market research skills.

milestones.label: Master digital marketing and social media strategy
milestones.description: Study digital marketing channels including SEO, SEM, social media marketing, email marketing, and content strategy. Students develop and execute a digital marketing campaign for a real or simulated brand.

milestones.label: Conduct market research and consumer analysis
milestones.description: Design and execute primary market research including surveys, focus groups, and data analysis. Students use SPSS or Qualtrics to analyze consumer data and present actionable insights.

milestones.label: Compete in AMA case competition
milestones.description: Collaborate in a team to solve a real-world marketing challenge in the AMA Collegiate Case Competition. Develop strategy, creative execution, and professional presentation skills.

milestones.label: Analyze brand strategy across cultural markets
milestones.description: Study consumer psychology, cultural influences on purchasing behavior, and how global brands adapt messaging and positioning across markets. Students analyze cross-cultural advertising campaigns.

milestones.label: Deliver community marketing project for local business
milestones.description: Partner with a local small business to develop a marketing strategy including market analysis, competitive positioning, and promotional recommendations. Apply classroom learning to community impact.

phases.name: Year 3
phases.subtitle: Develop
phases.description: Advanced Marketing Strategy & Professional Experience — Master brand management, earn certifications, and complete internship.

milestones.label: Master brand management and integrated marketing communications
milestones.description: Study brand equity, brand architecture, positioning strategy, and integrated marketing communications (IMC). Students develop a comprehensive brand strategy for a new product launch.

milestones.label: Earn Google Analytics and digital marketing certifications
milestones.description: Master marketing analytics tools and earn Google Analytics certification. Students analyze web traffic, campaign performance, and customer journey data to optimize marketing strategies.

milestones.label: Secure and engage with a marketing industry mentor
milestones.description: Establish a mentorship with a brand manager, marketing director, or digital strategist through CoBE networks. Monthly meetings focus on industry trends and career development.

milestones.label: Complete summer marketing internship
milestones.description: Secure an internship in brand management, digital marketing, advertising, or market research at a corporation, agency, or nonprofit. Apply marketing strategy in a professional setting.

milestones.label: Study international marketing and global strategy
milestones.description: Analyze international market entry strategies, global brand management, and cross-cultural marketing challenges. Students develop a market entry plan for a brand expanding internationally.

phases.name: Year 4
phases.subtitle: Launch
phases.description: Career Placement & Capstone — Complete capstone campaign, build portfolio, and launch marketing career.

milestones.label: Execute capstone marketing campaign project
milestones.description: Develop and execute a comprehensive marketing campaign for a real client including strategy, creative execution, media planning, and performance measurement. Evaluated by faculty and industry professionals.

milestones.label: Build professional marketing portfolio
milestones.description: Curate a professional portfolio showcasing campaign work, market research projects, digital analytics dashboards, and brand strategy documents. Create an online portfolio site for employer review.

milestones.label: Serve as peer mentor for underclassmen
milestones.description: Mentor underclassmen in marketing coursework, sharing internship insights, portfolio development strategies, and AMA competition experience.

milestones.label: Develop industry-specific placement portfolio
milestones.description: Assemble a career launch package targeting brand management, digital agency, or corporate marketing roles. Includes tailored resume, portfolio link, and documented industry network.

milestones.label: Complete exit assessment and career activation
milestones.description: Complete the CoBE Marketing Exit Assessment and finalize career activation documenting job offers, graduate admissions, or agency placements.
